extName.message: Sombre — Dark Mode for Every Website

extDescription.message: Dark theme and night mode for any site: no white flash, readable text with guaranteed contrast, one-click toggle per site.

commandToggleSite.message: Toggle dark mode on the current site

notAvailable.message: Not available on this page (browser pages, extension stores).

reasonAutoDark.message: Dark — global default (Auto, system is dark)

reasonAutoLight.message: Light — global default (Auto, system is light)

nativeStatus.message: Dark — the site's own dark theme

nativeHint.message: Sombre keeps it and only darkens what stays light.

engineForced.message: Sombre's engine is used instead of the site's own dark theme.

defaultModeHelp.message: Auto follows your system's light or dark setting.

contrastHelp.message: Minimum readability of text: Soft (APCA Lc 60), Standard (75), High (90). Large text gets 15 less.

shortcutHelp.message: Toggles dark mode on the current site.

sitesEmpty.message: No exceptions yet. Use the popup on a site to add one.

sectionNative.message: Sites with their own dark theme

nativeHelp.message: Sombre keeps their theme and only darkens what stays light. Forget a site to detect it again on its next visit.

cacheHelp.message: Converted stylesheets, so known sites get their full theme without waiting for the network.

privacy.message: No browsing data leaves your browser. Sombre only fetches the stylesheets of the pages you visit, to convert them.

pickerHint.message: Click the element to fix · Esc to cancel

fixesHelp.message: Made with "Fix an element" in the popup. Export them to contribute to the shared list.

importFailed.message: This file is not a valid fix list.

sharedFixesHelp.message: Fixes reviewed by the project, applied only when their signature checks out. Your own fixes come first.
